transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I’ve been having these times after late shifts where I stop and get food, and then when I get home I just keep eating. Like a full takeout meal, then chips, sweets, whatever’s around the apartment. Afterward I kind of look at it and feel shocked by how much I ate.
When you find yourself eating all that food after your shifts, do you feel like you can't stop or control how much you're eating at the time?

Yeah. Once I start on those nights, it feels like I can’t really stop. Part of me is telling myself, “Put it away, that’s enough,” but I just keep opening containers or bags until it’s all gone. It almost feels like I’m watching myself do it.
Do these episodes of eating leave you feeling really upset, guilty, or embarrassed afterward?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I don’t feel great about it, but I don’t know if I’d say really upset or embarrassed. I mostly just feel kind of uncomfortable and try not to think about it too much.
Do you usually eat this way when you're alone, or do you sometimes do this in front of others?
I’m not totally sure how to answer that. It’s mostly just something I notice happening after work when I’m by myself, but I haven’t really paid attention to whether that’s always the case.
After these episodes where you eat a lot, do you ever try to compensate by making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or exercising a lot more than usual?

Yeah… sometimes I do. Not really the laxatives or anything, but after I get home and eat too much takeout or snacks, I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up. It’s like I don’t want it sitting in me and turning into weight.
How often do you make yourself vomit after these eating episodes, and does it depend on how much you ate or how you feel about your weight or appearance?

It’s not every single time, but it happens sometimes when I feel like I really overdid it. Like if I get home and eat a bunch of takeout or snacks, then I start thinking about it just sitting in me and turning into weight, and that’s when I’ll go make myself throw up. It’s tied to how much I ate, and yeah, how I’m feeling about my weight.
About how often do these episodes where you eat a lot and feel out of control happen — do you notice them happening at least once a week, or less frequently than that?

Yeah, it’s at least once a week most weeks. Since I got settled into the new apartment routine, it’s usually late at night — I’ll eat way more than I meant to, feel like I can’t really stop, and then I try to make up for it somehow, like throwing up, skipping breakfast, or making myself go on a long run.
